verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own background automation primitives. Supabase Cron schedules recurring jobs, from every second to once a year, that run SQL, database functions, or HTTP calls to Edge Functions, and can be created via SQL or the Dashboard. Queues handles durable background tasks with guaranteed delivery, and Database Webhooks fire automatically on table events. The MCP docs also explicitly address unattended agent routines with read-only, project-scoped guardrails. missing for 10: explicit documentation of agents creating or managing cron/queue automations via MCP or the AI Assistant (only implied through execute_sql/deploy_edge_function), independent hands-on corroboration of background job reliability.
